messages:
sara: Quick sync — before I update the public docs, can we confirm the embeddings API contract for mixed inputs, empty items, and long texts? want to be explicit about truncate behavior + output shape.

mike: We accept either a single string or an array of strings for `inputs`. If a single string is supplied we coerce to a 1-element array.

olivia: For null/empty items: default behavior is to return `embedding: null` with `reason: "empty input"`. We prefer explicit nulls over zero vectors so consumers can detect missing content.

nate: Batch limits: 1024 items max per request. Also enforce an effective token budget per call (1,000,000 tokens). If exceeded we return 413 + message.

mike: Long text handling: we clip at ~32k characters (roughly 8k tokens) by default and attach `truncated: true` per-item in the response. We'll include the original `truncated_length` field in metadata.

sara: Can you paste a tiny example of the response shape so I can mirror it in the docs?

mike: Sure — example:
```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite-v2",
  "data": [
    {"index": 0, "embedding": [0.001, -0.12, ...], "truncated": false},
    {"index": 1, "embedding": null, "reason": "empty input"}
  ],
  "usage": {"items": 2}
}
```

olivia: One nuance: vector length depends on the model. default `embed-lite-v2` => 2048 floats (float32). We'll call out model->dim mapping in the model table.

nate: Also adding a query param `preserve_empty=true` for clients that want a zero vector instead of null. Default is false.

sara: Good. I'll document `preserve_empty`, `truncated` boolean, `truncated_length`, the 1024 item cap, and the 32k char clip. Will also note coercion of single string -> array.

ci-bot: docs PR #1824 created and linked: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1824 :white_check_mark:

sara: Thanks — tagging @olivia and @mike for quick review on wording. planning to merge tomorrow unless objections.

mike: :thumbsup:

olivia: looks good to me, just add a short example showing `preserve_empty=true` behavior.

sara: will do, thx!
